course_name_original: MABB510 – Praktisches Studiensemester Vor- und Nachbereitung
course_name_en: Practical Study Semester Preparation and Follow-up
prerequisites: Admission to the main study period

learning_outcomes.text: Students are taught efficient project planning and execution.
The fundamentals of scientific work in conducting experiments or similar are presented.
Students should be enabled to best complete tasks and projects in their practical semester.
The subsequent report and oral presentation on their practical semester also serve as preparation for the Bachelor's thesis, as the report is based on the fundamental structure of final theses.
To present measurement results and theoretical calculations in scientific diagrams.
To obtain and sort background information through scientific research.

syllabus_topics: Methods for project planning using practical case studies
Daily project work including project controlling
Essential project parameters: time, cost, quality, and performance
Theoretical content of scientific work presented in lectures
Presenting measurement results and theoretical calculations in scientific diagrams
Obtaining and sorting background information through scientific research
Presentation of one or more projects worked on during the practical semester
Q&A session on the presented problem
Current topics and developments from the field and environment of mechanical engineering

assessment_methods.method: Project handbook (project documentation) and participation in final workshop and final meeting
Coursework (oral exam, presentation, or term paper - ungraded)

assessment_rules: Assessment methods for sub-modules MABB 511, MABB 512, MABB 513, and MABB 514 are ungraded. MABB 512 includes a 60-minute written exam. The specific coursework for MABB 514 (oral exam, presentation, or term paper) will be announced at the beginning of the semester.
